日期：2026-03-01T08:00:00Z
主题：Equipment Provisioning Policy Update
Team,

Updated provisioning policy:

1. Full-time employees receive standard equipment package.
2. Contractors and consultants must provide their own equipment. Do NOT order equipment or create IT tickets for non-employees.
3. Remote employees get an additional monitor shipped to their home address.
4. Standard package: laptop (per department spec), wireless keyboard, mouse, headset.
5. Engineering: MacBook Pro 16-inch M4. All others: MacBook Air 15-inch M4.

- CFO"}
